detailed_descriptions.en: HYPERFIGHT 2 is the sequel to the original HYPERFIGHT, a fast-paced 2D fighting game where your meter is your life . This meter replaces a traditional healthbar - win by filling it completely OR knocking your opponent out of bounds. You'll need to balance risk/reward between using special moves and moving closer to victory. Resource management and space control are critical as the game changes with every interaction. This installment takes everything up to 11 - expanded movesets, more offensive and defensive options, and improved online features - while keeping the beloved accessibility of the original. NEW AND RETURNING CHARACTERS A fully voiced roster of characters, each with their own unique movesets and playstyles! Beloved favorites from the original return alongside some new faces. PLAY ONLINE, WITH FRIENDS OR FOES Featuring rollback netcode and menu-based lobbies. Create your own private lobbies, or join a public Quick Match lobby and instantly find opponents ready to challenge. Easy, seamless, and functional - so you can focus on the fight. PROVE YOUR MASTERY Complete objectives during a match to unlock cosmetics for your online profile! Each character has a wide variety of Challenges ranging from easy to very difficult - can you complete them all? SOLO CONTENT - LEARN, TRAIN, OR TAKE A BREAK Survival Mode : Try to survive an endless gauntlet of opponents Lesson Mode : Interactive tutorials on the game's mechanics, characters, and combos Training Mode : Practice using a multitude of helpful options Gallery : View official + fan art and listen to music from the game ...AND MORE! Funky and energetic soundtrack composed by STEEL_PLUS Full controller and keyboard support with rebinding, plus mouse support for UI Movelist display right on the pause screen, scrollable by P1 and P2 at once READY TO FIGHT?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
HYPERFIGHT 2 is the sequel to the original HYPERFIGHT, a fast-paced 2D fighting game where your meter is your life. This meter replaces a traditional healthbar - win by filling it completely OR knocking your opponent out of bounds. You'll need to balance risk/reward between using special moves and moving closer to victory. Resource management and space control are critical as the game changes with every interaction.

This installment takes everything up to 11 - expanded movesets, more offensive and defensive options, and improved online features - while keeping the beloved accessibility of the original.

NEW AND RETURNING CHARACTERS

A fully voiced roster of characters, each with their own unique movesets and playstyles! Beloved favorites from the original return alongside some new faces.

PLAY ONLINE, WITH FRIENDS OR FOES

Featuring rollback netcode and menu-based lobbies. Create your own private lobbies, or join a public Quick Match lobby and instantly find opponents ready to challenge.

Easy, seamless, and functional - so you can focus on the fight.

PROVE YOUR MASTERY

Complete objectives during a match to unlock cosmetics for your online profile! Each character has a wide variety of Challenges ranging from easy to very difficult - can you complete them all?

SOLO CONTENT - LEARN, TRAIN, OR TAKE A BREAK

  • Survival Mode: Try to survive an endless gauntlet of opponents

  • Lesson Mode: Interactive tutorials on the game's mechanics, characters, and combos

  • Training Mode: Practice using a multitude of helpful options

  • Gallery: View official + fan art and listen to music from the game

...AND MORE!

  • Funky and energetic soundtrack composed by STEEL_PLUS

  • Full controller and keyboard support with rebinding, plus mouse support for UI

  • Movelist display right on the pause screen, scrollable by P1 and P2 at once

READY TO FIGHT?
